I'm imagining the world as a network of connections and fragmented text—a globe woven from many voices and lines, seen through the lens of language, honest about its fragmented yet interconnected nature.

For the sphere itself I'll fill it with a gradient and clip latitude ellipses to create the meridian/equator lines, then scatter small node circles across the surface connected by thin lines to suggest a network.

I want to add a subtle day/night shading via an offset dark circle clipped to the sphere, evoking a "today, half-lit" feeling. Scattered around the edges I'll place tiny multilingual text fragments like "¿estás ahí?", "hello", "ayuda", "gracias" in low-opacity blue, representing questions arriving from everywhere.
